exercises.passage: Every year, thousands of tourists visit Dolphin Reef in Eilat. The dolphins there live in a large area of the Red Sea. It is closed with a net, but the net has an open part, so the dolphins can swim out to the open sea if they want to. Interestingly, most of them come back. Dolphins are very smart animals. They live in groups, and each dolphin has its own whistle, like a name, that the others recognize. They breathe air, so they must come up to the surface. Scientists believe that dolphins sleep with only half of their brain at a time, so they can keep breathing. Visitors can watch the dolphins from a wooden bridge or swim near them with a guide. The rules are simple: don't touch them and don't feed them. "We visit their home," a guide explains, "not the other way around."
exercises.question: Can the dolphins leave the area?
exercises.answer: Yes, there is an open part in the net.
options: Yes, there is an open part in the net.
exercises.explain_he: כתוב: the net has an open part, so the dolphins can swim out to the open sea.
